visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed rotating hero carousel. Each slide fills the viewport width with a background image; an overlaid content box (light background) sits at the lower-left with a heading, short description, and a single CTA button. Slide indicator dots are centered below the slides and prev/next circular navigation buttons overlay the lower-right of the slide area.
contentPattern: Rotating slides, each carrying a full-width image plus title, description, and one CTA link.
usage: Landing/home page hero region presenting 2 or more promotional slides that rotate or can be swiped/navigated.
